_flow_context.offer: none — do not mention a discount in this email

_instructions.copy_rules: No em dashes in any copy. Short sentences. Warm, helpful tone — not pushy. This email arrives 2 hours after checkout. The reader just forgot or got interrupted. Meet them there. No urgency language, no pressure.
_instructions.design_notes: Keep this email lean. Omit stats, split section, lifestyle divider, and bottom hero. Hero + intro + CTA block + category tiles is all this needs. It should feel personal and lightweight compared to a campaign email.
